name: @telorun/scheduler-build
description: Build-only package for the std/scheduler module's bundled controllers. Never published — the controllers ship inside the module artifact as pkg:telo/local/js bundles, so this package exists solely to declare the dependencies esbuild inlines.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && esbuild src/interval.ts src/cron.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --external:@telorun/sdk --conditions=source --outdir=. --banner:js='import { createRequire as __teloCreateRequire } from "node:module";const require = __teloCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' --out-extension:.js=.mjs
